summary: Man in his 70s with a previous ankle injury and cancer went for a hike near Allenspark; his vehicle was found October 22. Two SARDOC teams plus Larimer County SAR and Rocky Mountain Rescue searched; he was found deceased during a grid search on October 24.
responding_agency: SARDOC; Larimer County SAR; Rocky Mountain Rescue
notes: Date Friday-verified (search date); subject found deceased 2015-10-24. Seen in Fort Collins 10/20; vehicle located 10/22; RMR had searched the evening of 10/22.
